_doc: Phase-IP Slice-E dispatch-precision regression baseline (caddy). THE GATE: a future oracle run on this corpus_sha must hold dispatch_precision >= gate.dispatch_precision_floor AND sound_sites >= gate.sound_sites_floor. A decrease is permitted ONLY as a deliberate, recorded decision (e.g. a precision/recall trade in a refactor) -- paste the new oracle summary into the PR and explain the delta. recall_gap is reported, never gating (RTA pruning to live types is by-design precision). Regenerate: see eval/README.md 'Dispatch oracle' + the eval/tools/dispatch_oracle.py module docstring.
prism: PR-2 (#97), commit 13c3348; implementers field + ManifestSite forward-compat on branch phase-ip-slice-e

adjudication.protocol: dual-adjudicator Cohen's kappa (two independent adjudicators, operator-reconciled)
adjudication.note: The 21 judged = the 1 over_approx + the 1 oracle_timeout + 19 sampled sound sites (incl. the high-fanout CaddyModule registry sites). The remaining 42 sound sites rest on the oracle's definitional sound classification (prism set subset of gopls satisfiers).

prism_fp_sites.finding: 3-arg handler.ServeHTTP(rr,req,next) is the MiddlewareHandler signature; prism's constructor-local recovery minted the 2-arg HandlerFunc -- a name-based arity conflation. Test-only. Recorded in eval/adjudications.jsonl (measurement=interface_dispatch). Precision follow-up tracked in the deferred doc.

key_finding: CaddyModule dispatch recall is SOUND: every x.(Module).CaddyModule() site mints the 121-implementer RTA-live registry set, a subset of gopls's 132 satisfiers (the 11 extra are uninstantiated test/mock modules RTA-pruned by design). The type-confirmed dispatch PR-2 adds is sound recall, not over-approximation.

gate.rule: Future runs on this corpus_sha hold dispatch_precision >= floor and sound >= floor unless a decrease is recorded with rationale in the PR. Across-corpus-drift comparison re-anchors prism_fp verdicts by site_fingerprint.
